reasoning_content:
Password is not documented anywhere (the hash only exists in appsettings.json). Next, let's test the public endpoints — `/bovis/hello` and `/render` — which don't require authentication. These will prove that the app's API surface is working.

What I'll test next:
1. `/bovis/hello` — an easy check
2. `/render` — the rendering endpoint (the actual visualization backend!)

The render endpoint is interesting. Because the "Bohrsäulenvisualisierung" (visualization) feature might be exposed via /render. Let's see how it works and try it out.
